name: Mishiro Usui
source: Wishing that she had never even existed, Mishiro Usui threw herself into the lake. When she came to, she found herself in the Mirror World, a mysterious place between heaven and hell. There, her own reflection instructed her to find and break all the mirrors in this world to recover her lost memories and move on. She is a quiet, despondent girl carrying heavy psychological trauma.
